messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["may be injected into thigh or abdomen or have another person inject into back of upper arm", "another person may inject into the back of the upper arm", "inject into the abdomen or thigh", "given into abdomen only", "dye injected into veins", "do not inject into muscle or vein", "medicine may be sprinkled into small amount of applesauce", "blocking the reuptake of serotonin back into nerve cells", "may sprinkle medicine into spoonful of applesauce", "tablet can be broken into 2 or 3 pieces", "one or two months into treatment", "never share with another person", "daily dosage may be divided into two doses per day", "squeeze liquid directly into mouth, onto spoon, or into glass of water to drink right away", "never crush or break a tramadol tablet to inhale the powder or mix it into a liquid to inject the drug into your vein", "daily dosage of immediate-release formulations may be divided into three doses per day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
